analogy.rationale: c-Met is a receptor tyrosine kinase with limited expression in most of these lines, so MET inhibitors should elicit weak transcriptional responses; other RTK inhibitors (VEGFR, EGFR, ALK) share downstream MAPK/PI3K signaling and may show modest overlap, while broad tyrosine kinase inhibitor classes are less specific.
